blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police (PNP) has welcomed Malacañang’s challenge, vowing to pursue the arrest warrant against Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa saying his former position as police chief and personal ties will not stand in the way of law enforcement. “We welcome the challenge of Malacañang because it reinforces a fundamental principle of law enforcement: no position, rank, or personal relationship is above the law,” PNP chief Gen. Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said in a statement on Wednesday. “The loyalty of every police officer must always be to the Constitution and the law, not to personalities or former positions,” he […]...
